name: Zetharis
title: Hexblade Warlock
role: The party's ranged turret. In the Potent Robe, Agonising Blast adds his Charisma to every Eldritch Blast beam twice, and Hex adds more. From Act 2, Spineshudder and Ring of Spiteful Thunder turn the beams into control: Reverberation lowers CON saves, then Dazes or knocks targets Prone.

entries.note: adds your CHA to every Eldritch Blast beam
each beam can push its target, off ledges and into hazards
extra cantrips; from level 5 also Haste (an extra action: another Eldritch Blast), Call Lightning and Animate Dead
+1 CHA for 18, and double proficiency on Deception and Performance
see in magical Darkness: blast from inside your own Darkness spell (it replaces Hex as your concentration)
Mage Armour at will, for AC in the robe
if you skipped it at level 5
if you skipped it at level 5
cast Slow with a Warlock spell slot
cast Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot
crit range −1 on spell attacks, so every beam crits more often
if you skipped it at level 9
if you skipped it at level 9

gear.note: 3 temporary HP whenever you gain Lightning Charges. With The Spellsparkler that's every Eldritch Blast hit. They vanish if your charges run out. From Act 2, the Potent Robe's temporary HP take over. In the Underdark's Ebonlake Grotto.
Scorching Ray once a day.

+1 to spell attack rolls, which every beam uses. Next to an enemy it turns your beams into melee spell attacks, which Spineshudder and the Incandescent Staff don't count, so toggle Daredevil Proximity off from Act 2.
While concentrating on Hex, you can't be knocked Prone or moved.

Restore a spell slot up to 3rd level once a day. It's a swap-in: put it on after a fight, restore the slot, and switch back to Misty Step. Warlock slots go above 3rd level at Warlock 7, so it stops working for you then.
Bonus-action Misty Step each short rest. Your worn amulet in Act 1, so it's ready when a fight starts.
Spell and cantrip damage gives Lightning Charges, every beam included.
Adds your CHA to cantrip damage, so each beam gets it twice with Agonising Blast; temporary HP every turn.
Crit range −1 while you're obscured (stacks), and +1 CON saves for concentration. Better than the Covert Cowl.
Crit range −1 while you're obscured: blast from inside your Darkness (that turn you're concentrating on Darkness, not Hex).
+1 AC and saves. Alene passes it on once she has Cloak of the Weave.

Each beam that hits adds 2 turns of Reverberation (−1 to STR, DEX and CON saves per turn). At 5 turns the target takes 1d4 thunder and must pass a CON save or fall Prone. Attacks from within 3 m of a Prone target have Advantage; ranged attacks from farther away aren't affected. Keep it on in Act 3.
+3 m movement to reach high ground and keep your distance. Worn by Crusher at the goblin camp.
Resistance to poison damage, common in Act 1. On a skeleton in the Shattered Sanctum, before the Worg Pens.
Invisibility once per long rest: an escape button. On a dead deep gnome at Grymforge.
+2 radiant damage per beam against lit targets.

Damaging a Reverberating enemy Dazes it unless it passes a CON save. With Spineshudder, your second and third beams each force that save, and Reverberation has already lowered it. Moonrise Towers, from Roah Moonglow.
From the ranged slot: Haste once a day without spending a Pact slot, plus fire and cold resistance. Haste takes your concentration in place of Hex. Sold by Dammon at Last Light Inn.
+1 to ranged spell attacks, plus Fireball once a day.
An extra 1st-level spell slot and a self-Aid.
+2 CHA (up to 22): +2 on every beam, twice over in the robe.
Once per short rest, a cantrip costs a bonus action: a second Eldritch Blast that turn.
−5 to hit for +1d8 damage on spell attacks, toggled.
+1d6 force on every crit. Bhaal path only: Vesper can buy it from the Echo of Abazigal.
Can't be pushed, and can turn a failed save into a success.

+1 spell attack and DC. Its lightning buff gives 2 Lightning Charges whenever you deal spell damage, and a free Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt each short rest. Arcane Battery also casts one spell without a slot, once per long rest.
An extra 1st-level spell slot, and enemies have Disadvantage on saves against your Fear. No curse.
Cast Shield once per long rest without a slot, and Advantage on WIS saves.
+2 AC, and crits can't land on you. Forged from the party's second Mithral ore.

Act 1 armour until the robe: AC 15, no Stealth Disadvantage. Pearl has the Hollow's copy, so wear Breastplate +1 or Scale Mail +1, whichever a trader stocks first (from level 6), or The Jolty Vest before then.
The same AC as Breastplate +1 (15 + 2 DEX), with Stealth Disadvantage.
AC 14 + DEX (max 2). With Spellsparkler's Lightning Charges, anyone who damages you must save or be Shocked. Sold by Brem at Waukeen's Rest after Find the Missing Shipment.
Reverberating enemies that damage you must make a DC 13 CON save or be Dazed. It fills the Act 2 cloak slot. Sold by Araj Oblodra at Moonrise Towers.
+1 spell DC and spell attack, and it refills one Warlock slot once per long rest. A fallback if Markoheshkir's globe won't open. Sold by Helsik at the Devil's Fee.
For a Pact of the Blade Zetharis from Act 1: bound or Hexed, it's effectively +2 and can Bane the target on a hit. Its magic only works while bound. Sold by Blurg in the Underdark.
For a Pact of the Blade Zetharis: +1 to hit and damage and +1d6 lightning, but only as a pact or Hexed weapon. Sold by Dammon.

loadouts.label: Act 1
loadouts.intro: Medium armour and a shield until the robe; one beam until level 5.

loadouts.label: Act 2
loadouts.intro: The Potent Robe arrives: each beam adds your CHA twice from here on.

loadouts.label: Act 3
loadouts.intro: Three beams from level 10: stack Charisma, crit range or a second blast a turn.
